The '''explosives room''' was a storage room containing mining equipment in the [[Deepsea mines]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was held on a deepsea mine for multiple days and got his friend [[Guerra Derida]] to help him break into an explosives room to find a box containing an [[Ion bomb/Legends|ion bomb]], the most destructive explosive device in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
